clue.text: Call with a wave when bird grabs arm

parts.note: a bird of prey
a greeting you might call while waving

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher waves and calls out as a bird seizes someone's arm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arm' reads as a body part the bird seizes; here it means a weapon. The falcon opens up to hold the greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A falchion is a broad curved sword, and any weapon can be called an arm, as in firearms or armed forces.

clue.text: Wrap commonly thrust item

explanation.definitionFit: Kitchen aluminium sheet covers leftovers, while the fencing weapon of that name scores only by stabbing with its tip.

explanation.definitionFit: Lift-off is the moment a rocket leaves the ground, the physical start of a space launch.
